title: Airy Sweet Uruguayan Sugar Pudding
description: A light and airy Uruguayan dessert featuring sugar and a touch of resinous flavor, made with a whisk and paleo-friendly ingredients. This dessert is perfect for warm evenings.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the egg whites and salt until soft peaks form.
Gradually add the granulated sugar and honey to the egg mixture, whisking continuously until stiff peaks form.
Add the lemon juice and vanilla extract to the mixture, whisking until well combined.
Pour the mixture into 6 individual serving cups or ramekins.
Place the serving cups in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the cups.
Bake for 15 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the pudding from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate the pudding for at least 2 hours before serving.
